check: Algebraic consistency of component ratios vs aggregate ratio
requirement: S_FB must lie within mathematically valid weighted combination of component timings
formula: S_FB = T_B_FB / T_H_FB, where T_FB = T_forward + T_backward

validation.check_type: Verify that aggregate ratio matches component ratios within measurement error
validation.tolerance: 5% (accounting for measurement variance and run-to-run fluctuation)

component_ratio_analysis.observation: S_FB is always between S_forward and S_backward, weighted by component times
component_ratio_analysis.formula_check: S_FB = (T_B_fwd + T_B_bwd) / (T_H_fwd + T_H_bwd) = (S_fwd * T_H_fwd + S_bwd * T_H_bwd) / (T_H_fwd + T_H_bwd)

historical_consistency.note: Round-20 introduced std_ll (low-overhead baseline) to address wrapper overhead

std_vs_std_ll.issue: High-level rasterization() wrapper carries Python/alloc overhead (~1.3 ms fwd + ~4.2 ms bwd on bicycle)
std_vs_std_ll.impact: Original 'std' backend inflated HiGS speedup; honest baseline is std_ll
std_vs_std_ll.resolution: This analysis uses std (rasterization wrapper) as baseline B, consistent with original study design

run_to_run_variance.observation: std absolute times vary ±15% with neighbor-GPU load
run_to_run_variance.mitigation: Same-run relative ranking (HiGS vs std) is stable; cross-run absolute comparisons should use geometric mean
run_to_run_variance.example: bicycle std total: 50.8-52.3 ms across runs (rounds 14-20)

suspicious_ratio_combination.concern: Could S_backward >> S_FB indicate measurement error?
suspicious_ratio_combination.answer: NO - S_FB is weighted average of S_forward and S_backward; if S_forward < S_backward, then S_forward < S_FB < S_backward
suspicious_ratio_combination.verification: All test points show 1.03 < S_FB < 1.24, consistent with weights

forward_backward_asymmetry.concern: Why is S_backward (1.20-1.23) much larger than S_forward (1.04-1.16)?
forward_backward_asymmetry.answer: EXPECTED - HiGS forward is at parity (culling+gather offset subset-render savings); backward eliminates std's indexing_backward + native kernels avoid pipeline re-execution
forward_backward_asymmetry.evidence: Round-10 profile: std backward includes ~9.8 ms indexing_backward that HiGS eliminates; forward has no such asymmetry
